project_type: Interactive Digital Menu Web Experience (Awwwards SOTD Level)

brand.name: APERO — Café Bar & Tapas
brand.tagline: Buena comida, buenos momentos. / Te esperan en Apero.

theme.description: Milky White background representing the minimalist cafe day vibe, contrasted with heavy Dark Olive Green typography and elements.

fonts.usage: Primary/Display. Used for Hero kinetic text, section titles, and large editorial elements. Must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter) for sizes > 32px.
Secondary/Body. Used for menu item descriptions, prices, buttons, and navigation. Use lighter weights (300/400) for descriptions, and bold (700) for labels.

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: MUST import Google Fonts for 'Playfair Display' and 'Montserrat' in index.css or via next/font (if Next.js) or standard HTML link tags. Do not use Inter or generic sans.

colors.instructions_to_main_agent: Update tailwind.config.js and index.css variables to match these exact hex codes. Use the base #F2EFE7 (Milky White) for the main body background, and #2F4F3E (Dark Olive Green) for almost all text and structural borders. The accent (#D35400 - warm terracotta) is an E1 creative addition for interactive triggers, hover states, or 'Nuevo'/'Recomendado' badges.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid surfaces. NO glassmorphism. This is an earthy, organic brand. Pop-ups and cards should use solid Milky White or Dark Olive backgrounds with crisp 1px borders.
visual_enhancers.borders_and_radius: Keep it sharp or extremely subtle (rounded-sm). Avoid pill-shaped buttons unless it's a floating action button.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle CSS/SVG grain/noise overlay fixed to the viewport to give it a tactile 'printed menu' feel.

layouts.hero: Kinetic typography hero. Massive overlapping text 'APERO' using Framer Motion line-by-line reveal. Combine with an asymmetrical cutout or a beautifully placed interior photo.
layouts.navigation: Sticky top bar with categories (Tapas, Cócteles, Café) that updates based on scroll position. Use solid background or extremely heavy blur so text does not overlap with content.
layouts.menu_section: Editorial List Layout (Swiss Grid). Do NOT use standard grid cards for the menu. Use wide horizontal rows with a bottom border. Left: Item name & price. Middle: Description. Hovering the row reveals a floating product image that follows the cursor.
layouts.pop_ups: Item detail modal. Animate presence via Framer Motion. Should take up 80% of screen, split 50/50 between a massive elegant photo and typography details.
layouts.marquees: A continuous fast-moving horizontal marquee (CSS or framer-motion) with outline text (text-transparent stroke-primary) reading 'BUENA COMIDA, BUENOS MOMENTOS'.

motion.instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST install and configure '@studio-freight/lenis' (or 'lenis') for momentum scrolling to achieve the Awwwards feel. Use framer-motion for page load reveals (staggered fade-up), marquee loops, and the pop-up modal.

media.illustrations: Replicate the 'line-art mascot' feel by using Lucide-React icons (e.g., Coffee, Wine) heavily stylized with 1px strokes, or embed a simple inline SVG of a continuous line drawing. Never use generic clip art.

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements, buttons, menu rows, and modal close buttons MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='menu-item-tapas-1').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: No generic centered layouts. Embrace asymmetry, wide spacing (p-12, p-24), and structural grids.
Do not use complete transparent background in header if content scrolls under it.
Avoid AI slop: do not use generic shadows or basic bootstrap-like grids.
Ensure all text is in Spanish.
Use framer-motion extensively for scroll reveals and hover interactions to satisfy the 'MUCHO MOVIMIENTO' requirement.
